title: Sulfur Chud
description: Sulfur Cubes with big eyes and no mouths
body:
# New Textures
Changes sulfur cubes to have really big eyes and no mouths as well as updating the chiseled sulfur, which shows a sulfur cube.

I tried to make the bucket of sulfur cube item match the rest of the pack, but everything I tried looked terrible and I gave up.

Idea by my friend!!
